Desktop adjustment combinatorics — 2026-09 cycle, seam 2026-09-02

DRAFT — no combination here is locked; every chart is watermarked until the September forecast is locked.

Question: not every adjustment can ship this cycle, so which subset should? The Win10 headwind h (-726,000 at Dec-15, display layer, exact) is applied in every row. Every subset of the 4 droppable per-tile overlays is a real desktop model run with exactly that subset subtracted from training rows before mozaic and added back after, so interactions through the Prophet fit are measured, not assumed. Dec-15 values are the World 28-day trailing MA; deltas are against August's delivered 48,703,443 and against this cycle's all-in build 49,545,790.

  • Droppable overlays: i (india_excess), j (japan_bot), l (launch_at_login_new_users), o (mozillaonline_migration)
  • Always applied: h (headwinds)
  • Model config: {"holiday_effect_floor": -0.6, "holiday_max_radius": 5, "holiday_min_radius": 3, "holiday_threshold": -0.032, "prophet_changepoint_prior_scale": 0.1649, "prophet_changepoint_range": 0.814, "prophet_n_changepoints": 40, "prophet_recent_weeks": 17, "prophet_seasonality_prior_scale": 0.00825, "seasonality_corr_threshold": 0.0, "seasonality_regime": "multiplicative"}
  • Runs built 2026-09-08T19:19:59+00:00; report rendered 2026-09-08T19:49:53+00:00; actuals through 2026-09-06.
  • Caveat for the rows that drop l or o: both were already in August's published build, so those rows remove something the prior cycle delivered rather than declining a new addition.

Counterfactual: all five adjustments, h re-anchored to a chosen delta vs August

All of i j l o stay in; the Win10 headwind anchor is re-solved so the all-in Dec-15 lands exactly +479,000 above August's delivered 48,703,443. That requires an anchor of -1,089,347 instead of the draft -726,000: the headwind gets 363,347 larger (more negative), not smaller — i.e. it gives back that much of the +589,000 relief the September re-anchor introduced versus August's −1,315,000. Display layer only, so this is exact at Dec-15 and needed no model run; the ramp still starts at 0 on the seam and is flat after Dec-15.
